title: The Language of Nostalgia
grammar: Combining -ó/-ő and -t/-tt modifiers with negative participial phrases
goal: I can combine active (-ó/-ő) and anterior/passive (-t/-tt) modifiers within a single rich sentence.
I can construct negative participial modifiers ('soha vissza nem térő', 'semmivel össze nem téveszthető').
I can express nostalgia and temporal longing with literary precision.
